verdict.rationale: Sketch documents a command-line tool, `sketchtool`, for creating assets with a single command. It also claims you can integrate Sketch into workflows and server applications on any platform. Its open `.sketch` format (zipped JSON) supports scripted processing and git integration. However, the evidence never shows `sketchtool` running in CI, and the URL scheme, JavaScript API and local MCP server all appear to need the Mac app running. Missing for 10: documented headless or CI usage of `sketchtool`, clarity on non-macOS or server runners, a non-GUI automation API beyond asset export, and independent hands-on confirmation of CI pipelines.
